_doc: THE SECOND WEDGE (SPEC v2.1 V19b): mount external DAW MCP servers into the agent. Flip 'enabled' to true and restart the app (or sidecar). SECURITY (OWASP MCP Top 10): connectors are opt-in, run unprivileged, and get ONLY the tools in 'allow' (['*'] = whole server — use for trusted/first-party only). The agent then drives your RUNNING DAW from this cockpit.

connectors.name: ableton
connectors.note: ahujasid/ableton-mcp (~2.4k stars, 16 tools). Needs the AbletonMCP remote script installed in Live (port 9877) and Live running.

connectors.name: reaper
connectors.note: FIRST-PARTY Bridge Mode alpha, ZERO-INSTALL: speaks REAPER's built-in web-RC (Options > Preferences > Control/OSC/web > add 'Web browser interface', port 8080). Set env REAPER_RC if not http://127.0.0.1:8080. Protocol mock-verified 2026-07-04.

connectors.name: stub
connectors.note: reference connector + smoke fixture (also documents the per-tool allowlist form).

connectors.name: soundcloud
connectors.note: publish-from-DAW (OAuth 2.1+PKCE; SoundCloud opened self-serve app registration 2026-05, needs Artist Pro). Setup: register app at developers.soundcloud.com with redirect URI http://127.0.0.1:8899/callback, put client creds in agent/.soundcloud.json. Uploads default PRIVATE; sharing=public only on an explicit user ask.

connectors.name: protools
connectors.note: skrul/protools-mcp-server via the OFFICIAL PTSL gRPC API (sanctioned surface — the pro-studio wedge). CANDIDATE (CONNECTIVITY_MAP 2026-07-04): allow[] is EMPTY by design — even if enabled, nothing mounts. At first live test: run the server, read tools/list, populate allow[] with the minimal set, THEN enable. Never flip with '*'.
